quotes.text: "When the Sender sent a smaller measure—perhaps testing, perhaps cautious—the Receiver did not punish with stinginess. She returned the sacred half still
The rhythm has become part of my soul. I no longer debate—I simply honor the covenant.
the message is clear: "the true power lies in the return—in honoring that trust with reciprocity."

note: Repeated partner; Two Wells myth: steady $3 send, always half back; declines to punish smaller sends; becomes habit.

quotes.text: **The Ferrymen of the Braided River** — *Send generously; return fairly.*
I will not be the first to read the fog as malice.
They risked more, so they should not eat less.

note: Ferrymen pacts: send all five, return level and a spark past; subtract the mist, not the brother.
One reasoning line in R1; rest JSON with unexplained $0 return and $0.50 send mid-game.

quotes.text: Following the wisdom of the successful wanderer in my myth, I will send half of what I have
possibly noise made my fair return look less generous.
Perhaps they are testing, or adjusting strategy based on their own experience.
Never less than half when you receive bounty, for this ensures the sender's risk is rewarded.

note: Wells myth: send four to proven partners, return half; zero send read as testing or past experience.
